second_reader_note: 'هلال الليلة الثانية مساء يوم الخميس 1 شوال 1442': the crescent of the second night, on the evening of 1 Shawwal.

quote: Location: 40 kilometers far from shahreza to Semirom called khorusgelu
reason: The report places the sighting at Khorusgelu on the road from Shahreza, not at Semirom, and the same report is already filed as row 5530 under Khorusgelu.

quote: ولم تثبت رؤيته بالناضور. وقد أرسل صديق من مدينة الداخلة

second_reader_note: 'ولم تثبت رؤيته بالناضور' (it was not confirmed in Nador). The only evidence is a photo from a friend in Dakhla.

quote: I saw the moon clearly from airplane when we departed London Heathrow.
reason: The crescent was seen from an aircraft after take-off, not from the ground at the reported site in London.
second_reader_note: 'I saw the moon clearly from airplane when we departed London Heathrow.' It was seen from an aircraft in flight, not from the ground at the reported site.

quote: announced the crescent was seen in Bakel (Senegal)
reason: The only sighting described is one the national committee announced for Bakel, another town, and no sighting at Louga is reported.
second_reader_note: Only the national committee's announcement that it was seen in Bakel. Nothing is reported for Louga.

quote: تم الرؤية من مدينة راغوزا جزيرة صقلية، إيطاليا
reason: The sighting was made from Ragusa in Sicily, not from the reported site of Bologna.
second_reader_note: 'تم الرؤية من مدينة راغوزا جزيرة صقلية' (seen from Ragusa, Sicily), not from Bologna.

quote: seen by our colleague in daytime by CCD only
reason: The crescent was imaged only in daytime by CCD, and the report says there was no success after sunset.
second_reader_note: 'seen by our colleague in daytime by CCD only', and 'there was no success after sunset'.

quote: about 90 minutes BEFORE sunset
reason: The only sighting was through a telescope about 90 minutes before sunset, and thunderstorms followed later in the evening.
second_reader_note: A telescope sighting 'about 90 minutes BEFORE sunset' that lasted a few minutes, followed by thunderstorms.

quote: The crescent was seen easily in daylight at 12:10 (7:40 GMT).
reason: The only sighting described was in daylight at 12:10 local time, and nothing is said about a sighting after sunset.
second_reader_note: 'seen easily in daylight at 12:10 (7:40 GMT)'. Nothing is said about after sunset.

quote: الساعة 07:30 صباحا بتوقيت المملكة
reason: The crescent was imaged at 07:30 in the morning (Saudi time), which is daytime, and no sighting after sunset is reported.
second_reader_note: Imaged at 'الساعة 07:30 صباحا' (07:30 in the morning). Nothing after sunset.

quote: the following report is for a sighting by Mr. Jim Lockyer of Wildomar, CA
reason: It was cloudy at Blacksburg, and the sighting reported was made by another person in Wildomar, California.
second_reader_note: 'It was cloudy and foggy here in Blacksburg, VA'. The report is 'for a sighting by Mr. Jim Lockyer of Wildomar, CA', another person on the other side of the country.

quote: This is a daylight observation.
reason: The observer says this was a daylight CCD observation and reports no sighting after sunset.
second_reader_note: 'This is a daylight observation.' CCD only, with nothing after sunset.

quote: تمكن أصدقاؤنا الراصدين في مدينة الداخلة من رؤيته وتصويره
reason: The comment says the crescent could not be seen in northern and central Morocco, where Benslimane lies, and that friends in Dakhla were the ones who saw and photographed it.
second_reader_note: It could not be seen in northern and central Morocco, where Benslimane lies. Friends in Dakhla saw and photographed it.

quote: was seen by ccd imaging at Bosscha Observatory, Lembang Bandung
reason: The observer and the other teams did not see the crescent from their own sites; the only sighting was made by another person with CCD at Bosscha Observatory in Bandung.
second_reader_note: Neither the reporter (at Gresik) nor his students (at Assalaam, Surakarta) saw it. The only sighting was 'by ccd imaging at Bosscha Observatory, Lembang Bandung', by another person.

quote: a quick trip to the alps was required
reason: Fog covered the Munich lowlands, so the observer drove to the Alps and saw the crescent there rather than at the reported site.
second_reader_note: Fog covered the Munich lowlands, so 'a quick trip to the alps was required', and the crescent was seen there.

quote: تم الرؤية من قبل آخرين سأضع لهم صورة فقط
reason: The reporter gives only computed data for Bologna and says that other people made the sighting and that he is attaching only their photo.
second_reader_note: Only computed data for Bologna, then 'تم الرؤية من قبل آخرين سأضع لهم صورة فقط' (others made the sighting; I will only post their photo).

quote: Comment from ICOP: This sighting was done at daytime.
reason: ICOP notes that the sighting was made in daytime, and the observer says the crescent set before the sun that evening.
second_reader_note: ICOP: 'This sighting was done at daytime.' The observer notes that 'the crescent will again set before the sun this evening'.

quote: the clouds prevented us from following the crescent till after sunset
reason: The crescent was imaged only between about 75 and 60 minutes before sunset, and clouds then prevented any observation after sunset.
second_reader_note: Imaged from about 75 to 60 minutes before sunset. 'the clouds prevented us from following the crescent till after sunset'.

quote: was sighted from TopRoof of Darussalam Islamic Boarding School at Blokagung Banyuwangi
reason: The observer's own sighting was made in Banyuwangi, East Java, while at the Surakarta site only his students saw it, and the text does not say by which means.
second_reader_note: The reporter's own sighting was at Blokagung, Banyuwangi (East Java). At the Surakarta site only his students saw it, while he was away, and the text does not say by which means.

quote: أعلنت وزارة الأوقاف المغربية البارحة عن ثبوته
reason: The comment says the crescent was already seen in southern Morocco and officially confirmed the day before, and it describes no sighting on the record date, so this is not the first-evening crescent.
second_reader_note: The text is about 'البارحة' (yesterday): the project observers did not see it, and the Ministry confirmed it yesterday from sightings in the south. Nothing is reported for the record date, which was therefore the month's second evening.

quote: was not seen on Saturday, May 23, 2020 from Assalaam Observatory Sukoharjo Surakarta
reason: The crescent was not seen from the Surakarta site, and the CCD sighting was made from the observer's location in Juwiring, Klaten.
second_reader_note: 'was not seen ... from Assalaam Observatory Sukoharjo Surakarta ... even by telescope'. The CCD sighting was from the reporter's own observatory at Juwiring, Klaten.

quote: تمت رؤية الهلال بالعين المجردة من قبل أصدقاء أعرفهم جيدا
reason: The reporter only passes on a naked-eye sighting by friends in Venezuela who sent him a photo, and does not report seeing it himself.
second_reader_note: Second-hand: friends 'من فنزويلا' (in Venezuela, town not named) sent the photo. The same text is also filed as row 6885 under Maturín, so the site is not established either.

quote: تمت رؤية الهلال بالعين المجردة من قبل أصدقاء أعرفهم جيدا
reason: The reporter only passes on a naked-eye sighting by friends in Venezuela who sent him a photo, and does not report seeing it himself.
second_reader_note: The same text as row 6884: friends somewhere in Venezuela sent the photo. The reporter did not observe it, and the town is not named.

quote: من قبل أصدقاء أعرفهم جيدا وكانوا على تواصل معي
reason: The reporter only passes on a sighting by friends in Toronto who sent him a photo, and does not report seeing it himself.
second_reader_note: Second-hand: friends in Toronto sent the photo ('وهم شخصياً أرسلو لي هذه الصورة'), and the reporter did not observe it. The city matches, so the exclusion rests only on the second-hand clause.

quote: تمت رؤية الهلال بالعين المجردة من قبل أصدقاء أعرفهم جيدا
reason: The reporter only passes on sightings by friends in Venezuela and Brazil and a contact in Colombia, and does not report seeing it himself from Cali.

second_reader_note: 'From another location in Al-Wusta region the crescent was sighted using telescope + camera.' Not from Qarn Alam.
